title: Canonical object cohomology formula for an augmented comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], J its Zariski topology [def-sc-zariski-site], K its small étale topology [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and i:X.Opens→X.Etale a continuous functor. Assume abelian sheafification and Ext on both sites. Write L=i⁻¹ and G=i_* [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], assume L additive and preserving finite limits, and let f* be a family H^p(V,A)→H^p(i(V),LA), natural in A, commuting with connecting maps of short exact sequences and their images, and equal to evaluation of the adjunction unit in degree zero, as in [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback]. Let F be an abelian étale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], I an injective resolution of F and R an injective resolution of GF [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Fix a cochain map b:R→GI with ι_R⁰ b⁰=G(ι_I⁰). For every q≥0 and V∈X.Opens, there exist additive equivalences e₁:H^q(V,GF)≃H^q(R(V)) and e₂:H^q(i(V),F)≃H^q((GI)(V)) such that e₂(H^q(ε_F) f*(x))=H^q(b(V))(e₁(x)) for every x. Here ε_F:LGF→F is the counit. These equivalences are constructed from evaluation and Ext, not prescribed arbitrarily; the assertion does not provide the map b.

proof.text: Obtain e1 and e2 compatible with evaluated cocycle representatives from the cocycle-homology comparison.

For arbitrary x use Mathlib InjectiveResolution.extMk_surjective to choose a cocycle a representing x. Evaluate a at the identity generator, apply b in degree q, and apply the inverse sheafification/free/Yoneda section equivalence to construct the etale morphism c. The equivalence commutes with composition and sends zero to zero. Applying b.comm and the cocycle equation for a shows c is a cocycle. Applying the section equivalence to its inverse gives the required equality of sections.

The pullback-counit cocycle identity identifies the displayed composite on x with the Ext class of c. Substitute this equality, then use the cocycle-homology identity on a,c and their equal sections. This is the desired formula. The construction and surjectivity work unchanged at q=0 and for the zero sheaf or empty V.

proof_origin.note: E3 implements the upper proof from two distinct cocycle comparison obligations. Ext representative surjectivity is Mathlib; the transported cocycle and its cocycle condition are constructed and proved directly by the adjunctions and b.comm. No arbitrary data is chosen from a sorried theorem in a definition.

mathlib_searches.query: Extend a morphism from an object into a complex of injectives to a chain map from an injective resolution
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib InjectiveResolution.desc uses two resolutions; factorThru, exact₀, exact_succ and CochainComplex.mkHom give the required construction without exactness of the target.

Mathlib computes Ext by resolution cocycles. Existing section comparisons use global étale cohomology or only give a presheaf isomorphism; none gives this objectwise Zariski-to-étale formula for characterized fstar and arbitrary resolutions.

theorem zariski_etale_resolution_homology_data_exists
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [(sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)]
    (fstar : ∀ (p : ℕ) (V : X.Opens)
      (A : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
      Sheaf.H' A p V ⟶
        Sheaf.H' ((sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj A)
          p (i.obj V))
    (hfstar : (∀ (p : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (A A' : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (φ : A ⟶ A'),
        ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) p).map φ).app
          (op V) ≫
            fstar p V A' =
          fstar p V A ≫
            ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor X.smallEtaleTopology p).map
              ((sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
                (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).map φ)).app
                  (op (i.obj V))) ∧
      (∀ (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (hS : S.ShortExact)
        (hS' : (S.map (sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)).ShortExact)
        (p : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (x : Sheaf.H' S.X₃ p V),
        (fstar (p + 1) V S.X₁).hom (Abelian.Ext.comp x hS.extClass rfl) =
          Abelian.Ext.comp ((fstar p V S.X₃).hom x) hS'.extClass rfl) ∧
      (∀ (V : X.Opens) (A : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
        (x : Sheaf.H' A 0 V),
        ((Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ ((fstar 0 V A).hom x)).hom.app (op (i.obj V))).hom
            (((toSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology
              (yoneda.obj (i.obj V) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op (i.obj V))).hom
                (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 (i.obj V)))) =
          (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).unit.app A).hom.app
              (op V)).hom
            (((Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x).hom.app (op V)).hom
              (((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
                (yoneda.obj V ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op V)).hom
                  (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 V))))))
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (R : InjectiveResolution ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F))
    (b : R.cocomplex ⟶
      ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
    (hb : R.ι.f 0 ≫ b.f 0 = (i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).map (I.ι.f 0))
    (q : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) :
    ∃ (e₁ : Sheaf.H' ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F) q V ≃+
        ↑(HomologicalComplex.homology
          (((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
            (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).mapHomologicalComplex
               (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj R.cocomplex) q))
      (e₂ : Sheaf.H' F q (i.obj V) ≃+
        ↑(HomologicalComplex.homology
          (((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
            (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).mapHomologicalComplex
               (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
                (((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
                  (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
                    X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
                       (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)) q)),
      ∀ x, e₂ ((fstar q V
          ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F) ≫
        ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor X.smallEtaleTopology q).map
          ((sheafAdjunctionContinuous i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).counit.app F)).app
              (op (i.obj V))).hom x) =
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (((sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
            (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).mapHomologicalComplex
               (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map b) q).hom (e₁ x)
